text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 6) 2020.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh mulai 9 November 2020

hingga 17 November 2020.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Daging kambing tempatan bertulang

2. Daging kambing biri-biri import bertulang

3. Tomato

4. Cili kering

5. Kacang panjang

6. Timun

7. Kubis bulat import (Indonesia dan China, tidak termasuk kubis Beijing)

8. Bendi

9. Kacang dal (Australia)

Dibuat 4 November 2020

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/XII]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri

dan Hal Ehwal Pengguna

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 6) ORDER 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Control of Supplies Act 1961

[Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 6) Order 2020.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles

for the period from 9 November 2020 to 17 November 2020.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Local bone-in mutton

2. Imported bone-in mutton

3. Tomato

4. Dried chili

5. Long bean

6. Cucumber

7. Imported round cabbage (Indonesia and China, not including Beijing

cabbage)

8. Lady's finger

9. Dhal (Australia)

Made 4 November 2020

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/XII]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Minister of Domestic Trade

and Consumer Affairs
